g.text: Equal prices for every token ($4/M input, $20/M output, no discounts).

g.text: One-off ingest of the 184-meeting corpus is amortised over N questions per corpus.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #666666

g.text: TEST split, n=120. Filled = on the frontier (dashed); hollow = dominated; the oracle is a ceiling and never on it. Whiskers: 95% CI.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #666666

g.text: Summaries' cost excludes making the summaries (Granola does). Equal prices are a hypothetical list, not a bill.
